script: One of the farthest trips humans have ever made happened on a mission that went wrong. In 1970, an oxygen tank exploded on Apollo 13 on the way to the Moon. The crew used their lunar lander as a lifeboat. They swung around the far side of the Moon to head home. That loop carried them about 400,000 kilometers from Earth, a distance record for people at the time. All three astronauts made it home safely.
